raw.title: Houses for Sale in Dusseldorf, Germany
raw.snippet:
Dusseldorf's sophisticated real estate market attracts business executives, creative professionals and international families. Whether you're seeking a luxurious apartment along the Rhine promenade or an elegant villa in Oberkassel, ImmoScout24 connects you with exceptional properties. Combining commerce and creativity, refined lifestyle and vibrant cultural scene, Dusseldorf offers cosmopolitan living with authentic Rhineland warmth.

Property prices in Dusseldorf have been climbing steadily, fueled by strong domestic and international demand. As of 2025, the average price for buying property in Dusseldorf is **€5,518 per square meter.** The range varies dramatically across the city, from approximately €3,624 per square meter in emerging neighborhoods like Flingern to as high as €13,844 per square meter in premium riverside locations such as Oberkassel.

raw.title: Apartments for Rent in Dusseldorf, Germany
raw.snippet: Rental prices in Dusseldorf vary widely depending on the neighborhood and apartment size. The average rent for an unfurnished two-bedroom apartment in Dusseldorf is between €620 and €880, depending on the location. Furnished two-bedroom apartments in Dusseldorf generally have a higher average rent of €860. In the city center, you can generally expect higher rents, while similar properties in the suburbs have lower rents. The **average rent in Dusseldorf** is **€12.12 per square meter**.

raw.title: Finanzierungsrechner für Immobilien: Monatsrate kostenlos berechnen
raw.snippet:
Einfach Eckdaten zu deiner Wunschfinanzierung oben im Finanzierungsrechner eingeben und sofort eine geschätzte Monatsrate sehen.

Der Zinssatz beeinflusst die Gesamtkosten eines Darlehens, die Tilgungsrate bestimmt den Anteil deiner monatlichen Rückzahlungen. Ein niedriger Zinssatz spart langfristig Geld. Eine höhere Tilgungsrate beschleunigt macht dich schneller schuldenfrei. Zinssatz und Tilgungsplan beeinflussen also deine monatliche Rate.
